source_inspiration.pathforge_fit_adaptation: Outside demand shows people want stricter image/reference prompts and fidelity checks. This was adapted into an offline browser review board for scoring a reference-photo prompt across identity, pose, lighting, background, and no-drift constraints, with pasteable fields and copy/export handoff. No third-party prompt text was copied and no image generation/API wrapper was built.

steps.prompt_exact: Can you build me an offline desktop/tablet browser board I can save and open locally to review a reference-photo prompt for fidelity, with pasteable brief fields, score tiles for identity, pose, lighting, background, and no-drift constraints, checklist toggles, before/after constraint notes, and a copyable handoff?
steps.response_summary: DeepSeek V4 Pro returned a complete offline HTML reference-fidelity review board with pasteable fields, score tiles, checklist toggles, before/after notes, no-drift locks, local storage, and copyable handoff.
